content:
Here are several ways to write a Hello World PowerShell script:

1. Basic Hello World Script:
```powershell
Write-Host "Hello, World!"
```

2. With a Variable:
```powershell
$message = "Hello, World!"
Write-Host $message
```

3. With User Input:
```powershell
$name = Read-Host "Enter your name"
Write-Host "Hello, $name!"
```

4. Script with Function:
```powershell
function Say-Hello {
    Write-Host "Hello, World!"
}

Say-Hello
```

5. Full Script with Comments:
```powershell
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    A simple Hello World PowerShell script
.DESCRIPTION
    This script demonstrates basic PowerShell scripting
    by displaying a greeting message.
.NOTES
    Author: Your Name
    Date: Current Date
#>

# Display Hello World message
Write-Host "Hello, World!" -ForegroundColor Green
```

Choose the style that best fits your needs!
